table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	servicetype='Sale',
	serviceinvcode     = dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode,    
	date        = dbo.serviceheader.date,    
	flatdisc    = dbo.serviceheader.flatdisc, 
	/*salestax    = dbo.serviceheader.salestax, */      
	misccharges = dbo.serviceheader.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.serviceheader.discperc, 
	cashreceived = dbo.serviceheader.cashreceived, 
	doctype = Case dbo.serviceheader.servicecatcode When 10 Then 'Cash' When 11 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	amount =  Round(Sum (dbo.servicedetail.qty * dbo.servicedetail.price), 2),    
	servicediscpercvalue = Round(Sum (( dbo.servicedetail.qty * (dbo.servicedetail.price - dbo.servicedetail.serviceflatdisc) * (dbo.servicedetail.discperc * .01)) ), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( dbo.servicedetail.qty * (dbo.servicedetail.price - dbo.servicedetail.serviceflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.servicedetail.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.serviceheader.discperc /100), 2),
	salesman = dbo.users.username, 
	headerno=dbo.serviceheader.headerno,
	patientname = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = ISNULL(serviceheader.PatientCode, (SELECT PA.PatientCode FROM PatientAdmission PA WHERE PA.AdmissionCode=serviceheader.AdmissionCode))),
	tax = Round(Sum((servicedetail.qty * (servicedetail.price - servicedetail.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - servicedetail.discperc * 0.01)) * 0.01 * servicedetail.servicegstPerc ) +
			Sum(servicedetail.qty * servicedetail.serviceflattax ) +
			Round((Sum(servicedetail.qty * (servicedetail.price - servicedetail.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - servicedetail.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - serviceheader.discperc * 0.01)) - serviceheader.flatdisc )*0.01* serviceheader.serviceinvgstperc,2)
			,0)
FROM 
	dbo.serviceheader, 
	dbo.servicedetail,   
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.users  
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode = dbo.servicedetail.serviceinvcode ) and  
	( dbo.serviceheader.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
	( dbo.serviceheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode )and  
	( dbo.serviceheader.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            
	
GROUP BY 
	dbo.serviceheader.misccharges,   
	dbo.serviceheader.flatdisc,   
	dbo.serviceheader.date,   
	dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode,   
	dbo.serviceheader.patientcode,   
	dbo.serviceheader.admissioncode,
	dbo.serviceheader.discperc,  
	dbo.serviceheader.cashreceived,
	/*dbo.serviceheader.salestax,*/ 
	dbo.serviceheader.servicecatcode, 
	dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvgstperc,
	dbo.accounts.name,
	dbo.users.username,
	dbo.serviceheader.headerno

union all

SELECT 
	servicetype='Service Return',
	invcode = dbo.servicerheader.servicerinvcode, 
	date      = dbo.servicerheader.date,    
	flatdisc  = dbo.servicerheader.flatdisc, 
	misccharges = dbo.servicerheader.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.servicerheader.discperc, 
	cashreceived=0,
	doctype = Case dbo.servicerheader.servicercatcode When 15 Then 'Cash' When 14 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	amount =  Round(Sum ( dbo.servicerdetail.qty * dbo.servicerdetail.serviceprice), 2),    
	itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( dbo.servicerdetail.qty * (dbo.servicerdetail.serviceprice - dbo.servicerdetail.serviceflatdisc) * (dbo.servicerdetail.discperc * .01)), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( dbo.servicerdetail.qty * (dbo.servicerdetail.serviceprice - dbo.servicerdetail.serviceflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.servicerdetail.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.servicerheader.discperc /100), 2)     ,
	salesman = dbo.users.username, 
	headerno=dbo.servicerheader.headerno,
	patientname = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = ISNULL(servicerheader.PatientCode, (SELECT PA.PatientCode FROM PatientAdmission PA WHERE PA.AdmissionCode=servicerheader.AdmissionCode))),
	tax = 
			Round(Sum((servicerdetail.qty * (servicerdetail.serviceprice - servicerdetail.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - servicerdetail.discperc * 0.01)) * 0.01 * servicerdetail.servicegstPerc ) +
			Sum(servicerdetail.qty * servicerdetail.serviceflattax ) +
			Round((Sum(servicerdetail.qty * (servicerdetail.serviceprice - servicerdetail.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - servicerdetail.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - servicerheader.discperc * 0.01)) - servicerheader.flatdisc )*0.01* servicerheader.serviceinvgstperc, 2) ,0)
FROM 
	dbo.servicerheader, 
	dbo.servicerdetail,   
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.users
WHERE 
	( dbo.servicerheader.servicerinvcode = dbo.servicerdetail.servicerinvcode ) and  
	( dbo.servicerheader.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
 	( dbo.servicerheader.salesmancode=users.usercode)and
	( dbo.servicerheader.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            
GROUP BY 
	dbo.servicerheader.servicerinvcode,  
	dbo.servicerheader.misccharges,   
	dbo.servicerheader.flatdisc,   
	dbo.servicerheader.date,   
	dbo.users.username, 
	dbo.servicerheader.serviceinvcode, 
	dbo.servicerheader.headerno,  
	dbo.servicerheader.patientcode,
	dbo.servicerheader.admissioncode,
	dbo.servicerheader.discperc,  
	dbo.servicerheader.servicercatcode, 
	dbo.servicerheader.serviceinvgstperc,
	dbo.accounts.name     
ORDER BY 
	servicetype,
	serviceinvcode,
	date
table.sort: servicetype A, serviceinvcode A, date A

objects.name: compute_5
objects.expression: Sum ( if(  servicetype='Service Return' ,( - 1*c_discount), c_discount) for all )

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: Round(sum( if( servicetype ='Service Return',( - 1 * (netamount + tax)) , netamount + tax) for all)  , 0)

objects.name: netamount
objects.expression: Round ( (amount  -  servicediscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  + Tax
